explanations.title: 학습활동 1 (Reading): three pictures with signs
explanations.body: The book shows three pictures with texts (a Kobaco ad and two edunet4u.net pictures) and asks you to check the English description that fits each picture best. The pictures and their Korean texts are not in the text of the book, so I cannot give the answers; the English choices are:

rows: Using a cell phone while driving is dangerous.
Do not drive after drinking alcohol.
Buy this new hands-free device for safer driving.
Be aware of the damaging effects of wildfires.
Pay attention to fire hazards and always be safe.
Use matches instead of lighters to reduce greenhouse gases.
Looking for a witness to an accident

explanations.title: 학습활동 3 (Reading): a blog post, “열차 사고가 있었어요”
explanations.body: The following text is from a blog (a notebook post dated 2010/07/24, 21:17). The book asks three questions in English. The English translation is mine; 1시 40분께 is written 한 시 사십 분께 and 30분쯤 is 삼십 분쯤.

examples.text: 어제 오후에 저는 사촌언니 집에 가기 위해 오이도행 지하철을 탔어요.
examples.translation: eoje ohue jeoneun sachoneonni jibe gagi wihae oidohaeng jihacheoreul tasseoyo. — Yesterday afternoon I took a subway bound for Oido to go to my cousin’s (older sister’s) house.

examples.text: 한 시 사십 분께 금정역에 열차가 들어설 때 갑자기 열차가 흔들리더니 멈췄어요.
examples.translation: han si sasip bunkke geumjeongyeoge yeolchaga deureoseol ttae gapjagi yeolchaga heundeullideoni meomchwosseoyo. — At about 1:40, when the train was pulling into Geumjeong Station, the train suddenly shook and then stopped.

examples.text: 다들 놀라서 웅성웅성하는데, 기관사가 전동차가 선로를 이탈했다고 알려 주었어요.
examples.translation: dadeul nollaseo ungseongungseonghaneunde, gigwansaga jeondongchaga seolloreul italhaetdago allyeo jueosseoyo. — Everyone was startled and murmuring, and the engineer told us that the train had left the track.

examples.text: 다행히 지하철이 역으로 들어서기 위해 서행하고 있어서 크게 흔들리지는 않았어요.
examples.translation: dahaenghi jihacheori yeogeuro deureoseogi wihae seohaenghago isseoseo keuge heundeullijineun anasseoyo. — Fortunately the subway was moving slowly to enter the station, so it did not shake much.

examples.text: 그래서 다친 사람은 없는 것 같았어요.
examples.translation: geuraeseo dachin sarameun eomneun geot gatasseoyo. — So it seemed that no one was hurt.

examples.text: 열차 안에서 삼십 분쯤을 기다리니까 열차 문이 열리더니 기관사가 내리라고 했어요.
examples.translation: yeolcha aneseo samsip bunjjeumeul gidarinikka yeolcha muni yeollideoni gigwansaga naerirago haesseoyo. — After I waited about thirty minutes inside the train, the train doors opened and the engineer told us to get off.

examples.text: 저는 내린 후 사촌언니한테 전화를 하고 다른 승객들과 같이 다음 열차를 탔는데, 어떤 사람들은 버스를 타기 위해 환불을 받기도 했어요.
examples.translation: jeoneun naerin hu sachoneonnihante jeonhwareul hago dareun seunggaekdeulgwa gachi daeum yeolchareul tanneunde, eotteon saramdeureun beoseureul tagi wihae hwanbureul batgido haesseoyo. — After getting off I phoned my cousin and took the next train with the other passengers, and some people even got a refund in order to take a bus.

examples.text: 집에 돌아와서 뉴스를 보니까 사고 소식이 나왔어요.
examples.translation: jibe dorawaseo nyuseureul bonikka sago sosigi nawasseoyo. — When I came home and watched the news, the news of the accident was on.

examples.text: 아직 사고 원인은 알려지지 않았대요.
examples.translation: ajik sago wonineun allyeojiji anatdaeyo. — They say the cause of the accident has not been made known yet.

examples.text: 사고는 정말 누구한테나 일어날 수 있나 봐요.
examples.translation: sagoneun jeongmal nuguhantena ireonal su inna bwayo. — It seems an accident can really happen to anyone.

examples.text: 그래도 큰 사고가 아니고 다친 사람도 없어서 너무 다행이에요.
examples.translation: geuraedo keun sagoga anigo dachin saramdo eopseoseo neomu dahaengieyo. — Still, it was not a big accident and no one was hurt, so I am very relieved.

explanations.title: The three questions answered (mine)
explanations.body:
1. What happened yesterday? Include the time, location, and type of accident. At about 1:40 in the afternoon, at Geumjeong Station, the subway bound for Oido (the writer was going to her cousin’s house) suddenly shook and stopped: the train left the track (derailed) as it was pulling into the station.

2. What did the passengers do after they got off the train? They waited about thirty minutes in the train, then got off when the doors opened; the writer phoned her cousin and took the next train with the other passengers, and some people got a refund to take a bus.

3. Why were there no injuries? Because the subway was moving slowly to enter the station, so it did not shake much.

explanations.title: 말해 봅시다! (speaking)
explanations.body: Two speaking prompts of the book (the English is mine):

examples.text: 최근에 일어난 사고나 아직도 기억하는 사고 뉴스가 있으면 이야기해 보세요.
examples.translation: choegeune ireonan sagona ajikdo gieokaneun sago nyuseuga isseumyeon iyagihae boseyo. — If there is an accident that happened recently or an accident news item you still remember, talk about it.

examples.text: 고향에서 자주 일어나는 사고를 생각해 보고 이야기해 보세요.
examples.translation: gohyangeseo jaju ireonaneun sagoreul saenggakae bogo iyagihae boseyo. — Think about accidents that often happen in your hometown and talk about them.

lessons.title: 616. U15 L1 · Part 2 (본 학습): bridges, a bus crash on Incheon Bridge and car trouble
lessons.subtitle: 본 학습 · ~대교 · 인천대교 · 고속버스 추락 · 신원 확인 · 갓길 · 비상경고 등 · 안전삼각대

explanations.title: 알아봅시다: ~대교
explanations.body: In traffic reports about Seoul and Incheon, you often hear words that end with ~교 or ~대교, as in 잠실대교, 반포대교, 성산대교, 한남대교, 성수대교, 마포대교, 영동대교, 인천대교, etc. They all refer to bridges; ~교 means “a bridge” and ~대교 means “a large bridge.” All these bridges but 인천대교 are on the Han River, which cuts through Seoul. As the name suggests, 인천대교 is in Incheon and connects Incheon International Airport, which is on an island, with the mainland. The bridge opened in October 2009, and the direct access between the airport and the mainland reduces travel time from Seoul by as much as an hour.

explanations.title: 학습활동 1 (Reading): a news article about a traffic accident on Incheon Bridge
explanations.body: The following is a newspaper article (Yonhapnews) about a traffic accident on Incheon Bridge. The book asks you to read it and summarize it in English. The text is the book’s with the numbers spelled out (3일 is 삼 일, 1시10분께 is 한 시 십 분께, 영종IC is 영종 아이씨, 300 m is 삼백 미터, ages as 살, 24명 is 스물네 명, 12명 is 열두 명); the English is mine.

examples.text: 삼 일 오후 한 시 십 분께 인천시 중구 운서동 인천대교 공항 방향 영종 아이씨 톨게이트를 삼백 미터가량 지난 지점에서 운전사 정 모 쉰다섯 살 씨 등 스물네 명이 탑승한 고속버스가 도로 밑으로 추락해 열두 명이 숨지고 열두 명이 부상했다.
examples.translation: sam il ohu han si sip bunkke incheonsi junggu unseodong incheondaegyo gonghang banghyang yeongjong aissi tolgeiteureul sambaek miteogaryang jinan jijeomeseo unjeonsa jeong mo swindaseot sal ssi deung seumulle myeongi tapseunghan gosokbeoseuga doro miteuro churakae yeoldu myeongi sumjigo yeoldu myeongi busanghaetda. — On the 3rd at about 1:10 in the afternoon, at a point about 300 meters past the Yeongjong IC tollgate in the airport direction of the Incheon Bridge in Unseo-dong, Jung-gu, Incheon, an express bus carrying 24 people including the driver Mr. Jung (55) fell off the road; 12 people died and 12 were injured.

examples.text: 사고가 난 고속버스는 경북 포항을 출발해 인천국제공항으로 향하고 있었다.
examples.translation: sagoga nan gosokbeoseuneun gyeongbuk pohangeul chulbalhae incheongukjegonghangeuro hyanghago isseotda. — The express bus that had the accident had left Pohang, North Gyeongsang, and was heading for Incheon International Airport.

examples.text: 경찰과 소방 당국은 현재까지 사망자 열두 명 가운데 설해용 예순 살, 임찬호 마흔두 살, 이시형 마흔여섯 살 씨 등 세 명의 신원을 확인했다.
examples.translation: gyeongchalgwa sobang danggugeun hyeonjaekkaji samangja yeoldu myeong gaunde seolhaeyong yesun sal, imchanho maheundu sal, isihyeong maheunnyeoseot sal ssi deung se myeongui sinwoneul hwaginhaetda. — The police and fire authorities have so far confirmed the identities of three of the 12 dead, including Mr. Seol Hae-yong (60), Mr. Im Chan-ho (42) and Mr. Lee Si-hyeong (46).

examples.text: 경찰은 사상자 신원을 계속 확인하는 한편 정확한 사고 경위를 조사 중이다.
examples.translation: gyeongchareun sasangja sinwoneul gyesok hwaginhaneun hanpyeon jeonghwakan sago gyeongwireul josa jungida. — While continuing to confirm the identities of the casualties, the police are investigating the exact circumstances of the accident.

explanations.title: My summary of the article
explanations.body: On the afternoon of the 3rd, an express bus from Pohang heading for Incheon International Airport fell off Incheon Bridge about 300 m past the Yeongjong IC tollgate. Twenty-four people were aboard; 12 died and 12 were injured. The police and fire authorities had confirmed the identities of three of the dead and were investigating the exact circumstances.

explanations.title: 학습활동 3 (Reading): a newspaper article on road traffic safety
explanations.body: The following newspaper article is about road traffic safety (Hankyoreh). The book asks you to choose the phrase that can replace the underlined 멈춰 서면 (A. 세우면, B. 정지하면, C. 정거하면, D. 착륙하면) and to write in a table the suggested action for three car problems. The English is mine.

examples.text: 도로 위에서 차량이 멈춰 서면 어떻게 해야 할까?
examples.translation: doro wieseo charyangi meomchwo seomyeon eotteoke haeya halkka? — What should you do if a vehicle stops on the road?

examples.text: 고장이나 타이어 펑크, 연료 부족으로 차가 멈추면 갓길 등 안전한 장소로 차를 옮기는 것이 우선이다.
examples.translation: gojangina taieo peongkeu, yeollyo bujogeuro chaga meomchumyeon gatgil deung anjeonhan jangsoro chareul omgineun geosi useonida. — If the car stops because of a breakdown, a flat tire or lack of fuel, the first thing is to move the car to a safe place such as the shoulder.

examples.text: 교차로나 건널목에서 시동이 꺼지면, 기어를 중립에 놓고 차를 밖에서 밀어서 옮겨야 한다.
examples.translation: gyocharona geonneolmogeseo sidongi kkeojimyeon, gieoreul jungnibe noko chareul bakkeseo mireoseo omgyeoya handa. — If the engine dies at an intersection or a railroad crossing, you must put the gear in neutral and push the car from outside to move it.

examples.text: 타이어가 펑크 났을 때는 비상경고 등을 켜고 운전대를 손으로 강하게 잡은 상태에서 엔진 브레이크를 이용해 속도를 떨어뜨린 뒤 가볍게 브레이크를 밟아 정지하는 것이 좋다.
examples.translation: taieoga peongkeu nasseul ttaeneun bisanggyeonggo deungeul kyeogo unjeondaereul soneuro ganghage jabeun sangtaeeseo enjin beureikeureul iyonghae sokdoreul tteoreotteurin dwi gabyeopge beureikeureul balba jeongjihaneun geosi jota. — When a tire goes flat, it is good to turn on the hazard lights, use the engine brake with your hands gripping the steering wheel firmly to reduce speed, and then lightly step on the brake to stop.

examples.text: 고속도로나 자동차 전용도로에선 비상경고 등을 켜고 안전삼각대를 설치해야 한다.
examples.translation: gosokdorona jadongcha jeonyongdoroeseon bisanggyeonggo deungeul kyeogo anjeonsamgakdaereul seolchihaeya handa. — On a highway or a motorway you must turn on the hazard lights and set up a safety triangle.

examples.text: 안전삼각대 설치 뒤엔 가드레일 밖 안전지대로 나가, 경찰이나 보험사에 전화로 연락하면 된다.
examples.translation: anjeonsamgakdae seolchi dwien gadeureil bak anjeonjidaero naga, gyeongcharina boheomsae jeonhwaro yeollakamyeon doenda. — After setting up the safety triangle, go out to a safe zone outside the guard rail and contact the police or the insurance company by phone.

explanations.title: The questions answered (mine)
explanations.body:
1. 멈춰 서면 (comes to a stop) can be replaced by B. 정지하면 (stops): 세우면 means to stop something, 정거하면 is to stop at a station and 착륙하면 is to land.

2. The table:

rows: The engine has died at an intersection
Put the gear in neutral and push the car out from outside to move it
The car got a flat tire
Turn on the hazard lights, grip the steering wheel firmly with both hands, use the engine brake to reduce speed, then lightly step on the brake and stop
The car has a problem on the highway
Turn on the hazard lights and set up the safety triangle, then go to a safe zone outside the guard rail and phone the police or the insurance company

lessons.title: 618. U15 L1 · Part 3 (심화 학습): a reader’s column on motorcycle accidents
lessons.subtitle: 심화 학습 · 오토바이 사고 · 안전모 · 규정속도 · 지시등 · 준법정신

explanations.title: 학습활동 3 (Reading): a column by a traffic police officer
explanations.body: The following is a reader’s column in a newspaper (Hankyoreh). The book asks four questions in English (the best title, the advice given, a translation of the underlined sentence, and the article’s purpose). The text is the book’s with the numbers spelled out (41건 is 사십일 건, 4명 is 네 명, 1인당 is 일인당, 1만 달러 is 일만 달러); the English is mine. The underlined sentence is not marked in the text of the book.

examples.text: 교통경찰관으로 오토바이 사고 신고를 접하면 가슴부터 쓸어내린다.
examples.translation: gyotonggyeongchalgwaneuro otobai sago singoreul jeopamyeon gaseumbuteo sseureonaerinda. — As a traffic police officer, when I receive a report of a motorcycle accident, my heart sinks first.

examples.text: 오토바이 사고는 일반 승용차와 비교해 부상 정도가 크고 조금만 충격을 받아도 사망에 이르는 경우가 많기 때문이다.
examples.translation: otobai sagoneun ilban seungyongchawa bigyohae busang jeongdoga keugo jogeumman chunggyeogeul badado samange ireuneun gyeonguga manki ttaemunida. — This is because motorcycle accidents, compared with ordinary passenger cars, involve a greater degree of injury, and in many cases even a slight impact leads to death.

examples.text: 올해 들어 해운대 경찰서 관할에서 오토바이로 인한 교통사고만 사십일 건이 발생했다.
examples.translation: olhae deureo haeundae gyeongchalseo gwanhareseo otobairo inhan gyotongsagoman sasibil geoni balsaenghaetda. — So far this year, 41 traffic accidents caused by motorcycles alone have occurred in the jurisdiction of Haeundae Police Station.

examples.text: 이 가운데 네 명이 소중한 생명을 잃었다.
examples.translation: i gaunde ne myeongi sojunghan saengmyeongeul ireotda. — Of these, four people lost their precious lives.

examples.text: 오토바이 사고를 줄이는 방법은 결코 복잡하지 않다.
examples.translation: otobai sagoreul jurineun bangbeobeun gyeolko bokjapaji anta. — The way to reduce motorcycle accidents is by no means complicated.

examples.text: 아주 단순하다.
examples.translation: aju dansunhada. — It is very simple.

examples.text: 우선 규정속도를 지키도록 하자.
examples.translation: useon gyujeongsokdoreul jikidorok haja. — First, let us keep to the speed limit.

examples.text: 또한 차선을 바꿀 때는 반드시 좌우측 지시등깜박이을 사용하는 것도 자신의 생명을 안전하게 지킬 수 있는 좋은 방법이다.
examples.translation: ttohan chaseoneul bakkul ttaeneun bandeusi jwaucheuk jisideungkkambagieul sayonghaneun geotdo jasinui saengmyeongeul anjeonhage jikil su inneun joeun bangbeobida. — Also, always using the left and right turn signals (blinkers) when changing lanes is another good way to keep your own life safe.

examples.text: 이와 함께 오토바이를 탈 때는 어떤 경우에도 안전모를 써야 한다.
examples.translation: iwa hamkke otobaireul tal ttaeneun eotteon gyeonguedo anjeonmoreul sseoya handa. — Along with this, when riding a motorcycle you must wear a safety helmet in any case.

examples.text: 젊은이들은 헤어 스타일이 구겨진다거나 답답하다는 이유 등을 들어 안전모를 기피하는 일이 많다.
examples.translation: jeolmeunideureun heeo seutairi gugyeojindageona dapdapadaneun iyu deungeul deureo anjeonmoreul gipihaneun iri manta. — Young people often avoid helmets, citing reasons such as that their hairstyle gets crushed or that it feels stuffy.

examples.text: 하지만 안전모 착용이라는 불편과 생명 두 가지를 놓고 생각해 보면 어떤 게 현명한 일인지 자명하다.
examples.translation: hajiman anjeonmo chagyongiraneun bulpyeongwa saengmyeong du gajireul noko saenggakae bomyeon eotteon ge hyeonmyeonghan irinji jamyeonghada. — But if you think about the two things, the inconvenience of wearing a helmet and life, which is the wise thing is obvious.

examples.text: 일인당 국민소득 일만 달러 시대를 살아가면서 오토바이 운전자들이 좀 더 성숙되고 자발적인 준법정신과 자기 생명의 존귀함을 마음에 새겼으면 하는 바람 간절하다.
examples.translation: irindang gungminsodeuk ilman dalleo sidaereul saragamyeonseo otobai unjeonjadeuri jom deo seongsukdoego jabaljeogin junbeopjeongsingwa jagi saengmyeongui jongwihameul maeume saegyeosseumyeon haneun baram ganjeolhada. — Living in an era of 10,000 dollars of national income per person, I earnestly hope that motorcycle drivers will engrave in their hearts a more mature and voluntary law-abiding spirit and the nobility of their own lives.

explanations.title: The questions answered (mine)
explanations.body:
1. The most appropriate title: B. How to protect yourself from motorcycle accidents (the options were A. how to get a motorcycle driver’s license, C. why motorcycle accidents are more harmful than others, D. why young drivers are involved in motorcycle accidents).

2. The instructions and advice given: keep to the speed limit; always use the left and right turn signals when changing lanes; always wear a safety helmet when riding a motorcycle.

3. The sentence that most likely carries the underline is the one comparing the inconvenience of a helmet with life (translated above: “if you think about the two things … which is the wise thing is obvious”).

4. The purpose of the article: A. to persuade.

explanations.title: 말해 봅시다! (speaking)
explanations.body: The book’s speaking prompts (the English is mine):

examples.text: 여름철과 겨울철에 가장 많이 발생하는 안전사고는 뭐라고 생각합니까?
examples.translation: yeoreumcheolgwa gyeoulcheore gajang mani balsaenghaneun anjeonsagoneun mworago saenggakamnikka? — What do you think are the safety accidents that occur most in summer and in winter?

examples.text: 원인과 예방책을 말해 봅시다.
examples.translation: woningwa yebangchaegeul malhae bopsida. — Let us talk about the causes and preventive measures.

examples.text: 오토바이나 자동차 사고를 줄이기 위해 어떤 방법을 실행해야 할까요?
examples.translation: otobaina jadongcha sagoreul jurigi wihae eotteon bangbeobeul silhaenghaeya halkkayo? — What methods should be put into practice to reduce motorcycle and car accidents?

examples.text: 반 친구들과 토론해 보세요.
examples.translation: ban chingudeulgwa toronhae boseyo. — Discuss it with your classmates.

explanations.title: Activities left out
explanations.body: 학습활동 1 (a YTN news segment about escalator accidents in summer: categories of accidents, advice, and the meaning of the percentages 32.1%, 87.0% and 69.5%) and 학습활동 2 (a KBS accident news clip: the type and cause of the accident and what the 경비원 and the 119 구조대 did) are audio activities.

lessons.title: 621. U15 L2 · Part 1 (도입 학습): the Gaesung Industrial Park and a bus collision
lessons.subtitle: 도입 학습 · 개성공업지구 · 버스 충돌 · 통일부 · 속담 · 말해 봅시다

explanations.title: 알아봅시다: 개성공업지구 (Gaesung Industrial Region)
explanations.body: Gaesung Industrial Region is a specially designated industrial site in North Korea’s Gaesung City, 10 km (6 mi) north of the demilitarized zone (DMZ). 개성공단, or Gaesung Industrial Park, refers to the industrial complex created in the region, which was developed and is being operated in collaboration with South Korea. The construction began in 2002 and the first site of the model complex (시범단지) opened in 2004. Since its opening, the Park has expanded to include many hundreds of South Korean companies, employing hundreds of thousands of North Koreans. Under a 50-year lease contract between a designated South Korean committee and North Korea, the operation of 개성공단 has been adversely affected by political issues, including U.S. economic sanctions against North Korea, policies of the South Korean government, and incidents such as the killing of a South Korean tourist by the North Korean Coast Guard at 금강산 in 2007.

explanations.title: 학습활동 2 (Reading): a newspaper article on a bus collision in Gaesung
explanations.body: The following is a newspaper article about a traffic accident in North Korea’s Gaesung Industrial Region (Hankyoreh). The book asks you to fill in the EEIs (essential elements of information) in English, summarize the accident, and choose which of four points the article explains. The text is the book’s with the numbers spelled out (2일 is 이 일, 7시 40분께 is 일곱 시 사십 분께, 버스 2대 is 버스 두 대, 10명 is 열 명, 46명 is 마흔여섯 명, 2004년 12월 is 이천사 년 십이 월, 3건 is 세 건, 13차례 is 열세 차례); the quotation marks are removed. The English is mine.

examples.text: 지난 이 일 저녁 비가 내리는 가운데 개성공단에서 북쪽 노동자들을 태운 출퇴근용 버스 두 대가 충돌하는 사고가 일어난 것으로 뒤늦게 확인됐다.
examples.translation: jinan i il jeonyeok biga naerineun gaunde gaeseonggongdaneseo bukjjok nodongjadeureul taeun chultoegeunyong beoseu du daega chungdolhaneun sagoga ireonan geoseuro dwineutge hwagindwaetda. — It was belatedly confirmed that, on the evening of the 2nd, in the rain, an accident occurred at the Gaesung Industrial Park in which two commuter buses carrying North Korean workers collided.

examples.text: 이종주 통일부 부대변인은 칠 일 브리핑에서 지난 이 일 저녁 일곱 시 사십 분께 개성공단에서 버스 두 대의 충돌사고가 발생했다며 운전자와 탑승자는 모두 북쪽 인원이라고 밝혔다.
examples.translation: ijongju tongilbu budaebyeonineun chil il beuripingeseo jinan i il jeonyeok ilgop si sasip bunkke gaeseonggongdaneseo beoseu du daeui chungdolsagoga balsaenghaetdamyeo unjeonjawa tapseungjaneun modu bukjjok inwonirago balkyeotda. — Assistant spokesperson Lee Jong-ju of the Ministry of Unification said at a briefing on the 7th that a collision between two buses occurred at the Gaesung Industrial Park at about 7:40 on the evening of the 2nd and that the drivers and passengers were all North Korean personnel.

examples.text: 이 부대변인은 공단 안에서 발생한 사고이고 관련자가 모두 북쪽 인원이라 사고 직후 현장 통제와 부상자 이송 등 필요한 조처는 북쪽이 하고 있다고 말했다.
examples.translation: i budaebyeonineun gongdan aneseo balsaenghan sagoigo gwallyeonjaga modu bukjjok inwonira sago jiku hyeonjang tongjewa busangja isong deung piryohan jocheoneun bukjjogi hago itdago malhaetda. — Assistant spokesperson Lee said that since it was an accident that occurred inside the industrial park and all those concerned were North Korean personnel, the North is taking the necessary measures such as controlling the site and transferring the injured right after the accident.

examples.text: 이와 관련해 개성공단에 인접한 파주경찰서는 이 사고로 북쪽 노동자 열 명이 숨지고 마흔여섯 명이 다쳐 치료를 받고 있는 것으로 파악하고 있는 것으로 전해졌다.
examples.translation: iwa gwallyeonhae gaeseonggongdane injeopan pajugyeongchalseoneun i sagoro bukjjok nodongja yeol myeongi sumjigo maheunnyeoseot myeongi dacheo chiryoreul batgo inneun geoseuro paakago inneun geoseuro jeonhaejeotda. — In this connection, it was reported that Paju Police Station, which is adjacent to the Gaesung Industrial Park, understands that in this accident ten North Korean workers died and forty-six were injured and are receiving treatment.

examples.text: 파주경찰서 관계자는 경의선 남북출입사무소를 통해 개성공단을 오가는 노동자를 통해 사고 내용을 파악했다고 말했다.
examples.translation: pajugyeongchalseo gwangyejaneun gyeonguiseon nambukchuripsamusoreul tonghae gaeseonggongdaneul oganeun nodongjareul tonghae sago naeyongeul paakaetdago malhaetda. — An official of Paju Police Station said they grasped the content of the accident through workers going back and forth to the Gaesung Industrial Park via the Gyeongui Line South-North Transit Office.

examples.text: 하지만 통일부의 이 부대변인은 빗길 사고로 판단되지만 정확한 사고 원인이나 인명 피해 규모는 파악된 게 없다고 밝혔다.
examples.translation: hajiman tongilbuui i budaebyeonineun bitgil sagoro pandandoejiman jeonghwakan sago woninina inmyeong pihae gyumoneun paakdoen ge eopdago balkyeotda. — But assistant spokesperson Lee of the Ministry of Unification said that although it is judged to be a wet-road accident, nothing has been confirmed about the exact cause or the scale of the human casualties.

examples.text: 통일부 당국자는 북쪽 노동자를 태운 퇴근버스와 야근자용 출근버스가 충돌해 두 차량이 전파된 것으로 알고 있다고 말했다.
examples.translation: tongilbu danggukjaneun bukjjok nodongjareul taeun toegeunbeoseuwa yageunjayong chulgeunbeoseuga chungdolhae du charyangi jeonpadoen geoseuro algo itdago malhaetda. — A Ministry of Unification official said he understands that a bus carrying North Korean workers home and a bus taking night-shift workers to work collided and both vehicles were totaled.

examples.text: 개성공단에선 이천사 년 십이 월 시범단지 가동 이래 이번 사고 이전에 사망사고 세 건을 포함해 모두 열세 차례의 크고 작은 교통사고가 있었고, 모두 보험 처리됐다.
examples.translation: gaeseonggongdaneseon icheonsa nyeon sibi wol sibeomdanji gadong irae ibeon sago ijeone samangsago se geoneul pohamhae modu yeolse charyeui keugo jageun gyotongsagoga isseotgo, modu boheom cheoridwaetda. — At the Gaesung Industrial Park, since the model complex started operating in December 2004, before this accident there had been a total of thirteen traffic accidents large and small, including three fatal accidents, and all were handled by insurance.

explanations.title: The questions answered (mine)
explanations.body: 1. The EEIs and the summary:

rows: The evening of the 2nd, at about 7:40 (confirmed late; announced on the 7th)
The Gaesung Industrial Park, North Korea
North Korean workers (drivers and passengers were all North Korean); 10 died and 46 were injured according to Paju police
Two commuter buses (one taking workers home, one taking night-shift workers to work) collided; both vehicles were totaled
Judged to be a wet-road accident (it was raining); the exact cause and scale of casualties were not confirmed

explanations.title: The multiple-choice question (mine)
explanations.body: 2. The point explained in the article is A. The facts of the accident were confirmed by word of mouth (the police learned of it from workers going back and forth through the transit office). B is wrong because there had been thirteen earlier accidents; C is wrong because the North took the measures; D is wrong because no official report with the cause and casualties had been released.

explanations.title: 학습활동 3 (Listening): the proverbs
explanations.body: The book asks you to study three Korean proverbs, write the meaning or English equivalent, and circle the one that best fits an audio clip about traffic offenses. My meanings (the audio is left out, so I do not choose):

rows: a pie in the sky; something attractive but out of reach
spitting while lying down; (like) spitting in one’s own face, harming oneself by harming others
a needle thief becomes a cow thief; small wrongdoings grow into big crimes

explanations.title: 말해 봅시다! (speaking)
explanations.body: The book’s speaking prompts (the English is mine):

examples.text: 자기 자신이나 가족 등 가까운 사람의 교통법규 위반 사례에 대해서 서로 이야기해 보세요.
examples.translation: jagi jasinina gajok deung gakkaun saramui gyotongbeopgyu wiban saryee daehaeseo seoro iyagihae boseyo. — Talk with each other about cases of traffic-law violations by yourself or by people close to you, such as family.

examples.text: 미국에서 자주 발생하는 범죄에 대해서 이야기해 보세요.
examples.translation: migugeseo jaju balsaenghaneun beomjoee daehaeseo iyagihae boseyo. — Talk about the crimes that often occur in the United States.

explanations.title: Activities left out
explanations.body: 학습활동 1 (listening to six news clips from YTN about incidents, accidents and crimes: checking the topic and writing Korean key words, and a second set of two clips with a summary) and 학습활동 3 (listening to a clip about traffic offenses from the Seoul Education Research & Information Institute: the typical sequence of offenses of repeat violators and why they occur in that sequence) are audio activities.

lessons.title: 623. U15 L2 · Part 2 (본 학습): a K21 armored vehicle accident and three diaries
lessons.subtitle: 본 학습 · 장갑차 사고 · 도하훈련 · 저수지 · 일기 · 손 씻기 · 신발 정리 · 책 정리

explanations.title: 학습활동 1 (Reading): an article on an army accident
explanations.body: The following is a newspaper article about an accident in the army (Hankyoreh). The book asks you to pull out the EEIs and summarize the article. The text is the book’s with the numbers and letters spelled out (29일 is 이십구 일, 1시50분께 is 한 시 오십 분께, K21 is 케이이십일, 1명 is 한 명, ㄷ사 is 디귿사, 23 is 스물세 살, 5대 is 다섯 대, 16명 is 열여섯 명, 28일 is 이십팔 일); the English is mine.

examples.text: 이십구 일 오후 한 시 오십 분께 전남 장성군 삼서면 상무대 육군기계화학교 수상조종 훈련장에서 육군 전투장갑차케이이십일가 저수지에 빠져 부사관 한 명이 숨졌다.
examples.translation: isipgu il ohu han si osip bunkke jeonnam jangseonggun samseomyeon sangmudae yukgungigyehwahakgyo susangjojong hullyeonjangeseo yukgun jeontujanggapchakeiisibilga jeosujie ppajeo busagwan han myeongi sumjeotda. — On the 29th at about 1:50 in the afternoon, at the amphibious driving training ground of the Army Mechanized School at Sangmudae, Samseo-myeon, Jangseong-gun, South Jeolla, an army infantry fighting vehicle (K21) fell into a reservoir and one noncommissioned officer died.

examples.text: 이날 사고는 장갑차 제조업체 디귿사 직원이 교관인 김 아무개 스물세 살 중사진급 예정와 조교 임무를 수행할 예정인 이등병을 대상으로 교육을 하던 중 일어났다.
examples.translation: inal sagoneun janggapcha jejoeopche digeutsa jigwoni gyogwanin gim amugae seumulse sal jungsajingeup yejeongwa jogyo immureul suhaenghal yejeongin ideungbyeongeul daesangeuro gyoyugeul hadeon jung ireonatda. — The accident that day happened while an employee of company D, the armored vehicle manufacturer, was giving training to the instructor Sergeant Kim (23) (to be promoted) and a private second class who was to carry out the duties of an assistant instructor.

examples.text: 사고 직후 제조업체 직원과 현역 이등병은 탈출했지만, 조종을 맡았던 김 중사는 안에 갇혀 장갑차 바닥에서 숨진 채 발견됐다.
examples.translation: sago jiku jejoeopche jigwongwa hyeonyeok ideungbyeongeun talchulhaetjiman, jojongeul matatdeon gim jungsaneun ane gacheo janggapcha badageseo sumjin chae balgyeondwaetda. — Right after the accident the manufacturer’s employee and the active-duty private escaped, but Sergeant Kim, who had been at the controls, was trapped inside and was found dead on the floor of the armored vehicle.

examples.text: 육군기계화학교는 최근 케이이십일 장갑차 다섯 대를 배치받아 열여섯 명을 대상으로 이십팔 일부터 강을 건너는 도하훈련을 실시하고 있었다.
examples.translation: yukgungigyehwahakgyoneun choegeun keiisibil janggapcha daseot daereul baechibada yeollyeoseot myeongeul daesangeuro isippal ilbuteo gangeul geonneoneun dohahullyeoneul silsihago isseotda. — The Army Mechanized School had recently been assigned five K21 armored vehicles and had been carrying out river-crossing training for sixteen people since the 28th.

examples.text: 케이이십일 장갑차는 우리 기술로 개발돼 지난해부터 실전에 배치됐다.
examples.translation: keiisibil janggapchaneun uri gisullo gaebaldwae jinanhaebuteo siljeone baechidwaetda. — The K21 armored vehicle was developed with our technology and has been deployed for real operations since last year.

examples.text: 지난해에도 도하훈련 도중 엔진이 정지한 적이 있어 장비 결함 가능성도 제기되고 있다.
examples.translation: jinanhaeedo dohahullyeon dojung enjini jeongjihan jeogi isseo jangbi gyeolham ganeungseongdo jegidoego itda. — Last year too there was an occasion when the engine stopped during river-crossing training, so the possibility of an equipment defect is also being raised.

rows: The 29th, about 1:50 in the afternoon (the training had begun on the 28th)
The amphibious driving training ground of the Army Mechanized School, Sangmudae, Jangseong-gun, South Jeolla
Sergeant Kim (23, the instructor, to be promoted), who was at the controls, died; a manufacturer’s employee and an active-duty private escaped
An army K21 infantry fighting vehicle fell into a reservoir and one noncommissioned officer died

It happened during river-crossing (도하) training led by an employee of the manufacturer; the sergeant was trapped inside; an equipment defect is suspected because the engine had stopped in a training exercise last year

explanations.title: 학습활동 3 (Listening): three diary entries
explanations.body: The book prints three diary entries (journal entries) and asks you to decide, after listening to an audio clip, which one most closely reflects the message of the clip. The clip is left out, but the three entries are in the book’s text; the dates are written out and the English is mine. The first entry is about washing hands:

examples.text: 삼 월 삼 일 화요일 흐림
examples.translation: sam wol sam il hwayoil heurim — Tuesday, March 3, cloudy

examples.text: 오늘 체육 시간에 손 씻는 습관에 대해 배웠다.
examples.translation: oneul cheyuk sigane son ssinneun seupgwane daehae baewotda. — Today in P.E. class I learned about the habit of washing hands.

examples.text: 건강을 지키는데 자주 손을 씻는 것만큼 좋을 것이 없다고 한다.
examples.translation: geongangeul jikineunde jaju soneul ssinneun geonmankeum joeul geosi eopdago handa. — They say there is nothing as good for keeping healthy as washing your hands often.

examples.text: 자주 씻는 것도 중요하지만 제대로 씻는 것이 더 중요하다.
examples.translation: jaju ssinneun geotdo jungyohajiman jedaero ssinneun geosi deo jungyohada. — Washing often is important, but washing properly is more important.

examples.text: 먼저 시계나 반지는 풀고 씻는 것이 좋다.
examples.translation: meonjeo sigyena banjineun pulgo ssinneun geosi jota. — First, it is good to take off your watch or ring before washing.

examples.text: 흐르는 물에 비누를 이용해서 닦고, 손가락 하나하나와 손등 손바닥을 잘 문질러서 닦아야 한다.
examples.translation: heureuneun mure binureul iyonghaeseo dakgo, songarak hanahanawa sondeung sonbadageul jal munjilleoseo dakkaya handa. — You should wash with soap under running water, rubbing each finger, the back of the hand and the palm well.

examples.text: 나는 일 년 내내 감기에 자주 걸리는 편인데 이번에 배운 대로 손 씻는 습관을 바꿔 봐야겠다.
examples.translation: naneun il nyeon naenae gamgie jaju geollineun pyeoninde ibeone baeun daero son ssinneun seupgwaneul bakkwo bwayagetda. — I tend to catch colds often all year round, so I should try changing my hand-washing habit as I learned this time.

examples.text: 감기 뚝
examples.translation: gamgi ttuk — Goodbye, colds!

explanations.title: The second diary entry: tidying shoes

examples.text: 칠 월 팔 일 일요일 장맛비
examples.translation: chil wol pal il iryoil jangmatbi — Sunday, July 8, monsoon rain

examples.text: 오늘은 내가 사랑의 신발 정리를 했다.
examples.translation: oneureun naega sarangui sinbal jeongnireul haetda. — Today I did the shoe-tidying of love.

examples.text: 식구들의 신발의 흙과 먼지를 털고 깨끗이 닦아서 잘 놓았다.
examples.translation: sikgudeurui sinbarui heulgwa meonjireul teolgo kkaekkeusi dakkaseo jal noatda. — I shook off the soil and dust from my family’s shoes, wiped them clean and arranged them well.

examples.text: 난 행복했다.
examples.translation: nan haengbokaetda. — I was happy.

examples.text: 선생님이 말씀하셨다.
examples.translation: seonsaengnimi malsseumhasyeotda. — The teacher said:

examples.text: 현관에 신발이 어지럽게 놓여 있는 집은 도둑질 하기가 쉽고, 신발 정리가 잘 된 집은 주인에게 붙잡힐 확률이 많아 도둑이 포기한다고 했다.
examples.translation: hyeongwane sinbari eojireopge noyeo inneun jibeun dodukjil hagiga swipgo, sinbal jeongniga jal doen jibeun juinege butjapil hwangnyuri mana dodugi pogihandago haetda. — A house where shoes are left in a mess at the entrance is easy to burgle, while at a house where the shoes are tidy, the thief is more likely to be caught by the owner, so the thief gives up.

examples.text: 신발 정리를 하니 내 기분이 좋아졌다.
examples.translation: sinbal jeongnireul hani nae gibuni joajeotda. — I felt better after tidying the shoes.

examples.text: 우리 식구들이 신발을 신고 나처럼 기분 좋아했으면 좋겠다.
examples.translation: uri sikgudeuri sinbareul singo nacheoreom gibun joahaesseumyeon joketda. — I hope my family will put on the shoes and feel good like me.

explanations.title: The third diary entry: tidying books

examples.text: 십이 월 십이 일 목요일 맑음
examples.translation: sibi wol sibi il mogyoil malgeum — Thursday, December 12, clear

examples.text: 오늘은 책 정리를 했다.
examples.translation: oneureun chaek jeongnireul haetda. — Today I tidied my books.

examples.text: 그동안 읽었던 책 중에서 다시 읽고 싶은 것들만 따로 책꽂이에 놓고, 다 읽거나 불필요한 책들은 따로 싸 두었다.
examples.translation: geudongan ilgeotdeon chaek jungeseo dasi ilgo sipeun geotdeulman ttaro chaekkojie noko, da ilgeona bulpiryohan chaekdeureun ttaro ssa dueotda. — Of the books I had read, I put only those I want to read again on the bookshelf, and packed the ones I finished or do not need separately.

examples.text: 책상을 정리하니까 기분이 좋고 공부도 더 잘 되는 것 같다.
examples.translation: chaeksangeul jeongnihanikka gibuni joko gongbudo deo jal doeneun geot gatda. — I feel good after tidying the desk, and studying seems to go better too.

examples.text: 내일은 싸 둔 책들을 학교에 가지고 가려고 한다.
examples.translation: naeireun ssa dun chaekdeureul hakgyoe gajigo garyeogo handa. — Tomorrow I plan to take the packed books to school.

examples.text: 학교에서는 모은 책들을 고아원이나 가난한 아이들에게 보내줄 것이다.
examples.translation: hakgyoeseoneun moeun chaekdeureul goawonina gananhan aideurege bonaejul geosida. — At school they will send the collected books to orphanages or poor children.

examples.text: 내 책이 다른 아이들에게 도움이 되길 바란다.
examples.translation: nae chaegi dareun aideurege doumi doegil baranda. — I hope my books will help other children.

explanations.title: 말해 봅시다! (speaking)
explanations.body: The book’s speaking prompts (the English is mine):

examples.text: 미국에서 발생했던 군 장비 관련 사고 뉴스에 대해 서로 이야기해 보세요.
examples.translation: migugeseo balsaenghaetdeon gun jangbi gwallyeon sago nyuseue daehae seoro iyagihae boseyo. — Talk with each other about news of accidents related to military equipment that occurred in the United States.

examples.text: 북한이 일으키는 군사적 도발에 대해 한국과 미국, 그리고 국제사회가 어떻게 대응할지 서로 이야기해 보세요.
examples.translation: bukani ireukineun gunsajeok dobare daehae hangukgwa miguk, geurigo gukjesahoega eotteoke daeeunghalji seoro iyagihae boseyo. — Talk with each other about how South Korea, the United States and the international community will respond to the military aggression North Korea causes.

explanations.title: Activities left out
explanations.body: 학습활동 2 (a commentary by North Korean TV, Korean Central Broadcasting, on the March 2010 sinking of the South Korean navy ship Cheonan: translating four phrases with North Korean words, checking the speculated causes, North Korea’s position and the argument likely to follow) and the audio part of 학습활동 3 (what two examples the speaker uses, the message, and which entry reflects it) are audio activities.

lessons.title: 625. U15 L2 · Part 3 (심화 학습): a commentary on F-5 fighter accidents
lessons.subtitle: 심화 학습 · 에프 오 전투기 · 공군 사고 · 천안함 · 안전관리 · 비행 안전

explanations.title: 학습활동 2 (Reading): a commentary in a news weekly
explanations.body: The following is a commentary in a news weekly about F-5 fighter accidents (Hankyoreh). The book asks you to read the introductory and concluding paragraphs below, list the accidents related to F-5s and summarize the writer’s suggestion (and, in pairs, to summarize part of the article on the characteristics and defects of the F-5; that part is not printed in the text). The text is the book’s with the numbers and letters spelled out (F5 is 에프 오, 2000년대 is 이천 년대, 11건 is 열한 건, 8건 is 여덟 건); the English is mine.

examples.text: 최근 공군의 에프 오 전투기 사고가 부쩍 늘면서 국민적 우려와 의혹의 시선이 모이고 있다.
examples.translation: choegeun gonggunui epeu o jeontugi sagoga bujjeok neulmyeonseo gungminjeok uryeowa uihogui siseoni moigo itda. — As accidents of the Air Force’s F-5 fighters have recently increased remarkably, the public’s worry and gaze of suspicion are gathering.

examples.text: 이는 당연한 결과이기도 하다.
examples.translation: ineun dangyeonhan gyeolgwaigido hada. — This is also a natural result.

examples.text: 그렇지 않아도 천안함 사태로 군의 전비태세가 논란이 되고 있는데, 우리의 영공 방위를 책임지는 전투기, 그것도 숫자로 볼 때 가장 많은 비중을 차지하는 에프 오가 연이어 사고를 당했기 때문이다.
examples.translation: geureochi anado cheonanham sataero gunui jeonbitaesega nollani doego inneunde, uriui yeonggong bangwireul chaegimjineun jeontugi, geugeotdo sutjaro bol ttae gajang maneun bijungeul chajihaneun epeu oga yeonieo sagoreul danghaetgi ttaemunida. — Even without this, the military’s readiness for war is in controversy because of the Cheonan incident, and it is because the F-5, a fighter responsible for the defense of our airspace and the one that accounts for the largest share in number, has had accidents one after another.

examples.text: 이천 년대 이후 공군에서 발생한 열한 건의 사고 가운데 여덟 건이 에프 오 사고다.
examples.translation: icheon nyeondae ihu gongguneseo balsaenghan yeolhan geonui sago gaunde yeodeol geoni epeu o sagoda. — Of the eleven accidents that occurred in the Air Force since the 2000s, eight were F-5 accidents.

examples.text: 이는 단순한 기체 노후화의 문제인가, 아니면 다른 구조적인 문제가 있는 것일까?
examples.translation: ineun dansunhan giche nohuhwaui munjeinga, animyeon dareun gujojeogin munjega inneun geosilkka? — Is this a simple matter of the aging of the airframe, or is there some other structural problem?

examples.text: 이 글에서는 에프 오 사고와 관련된 환경적 요인을 분석하고 대책을 제시하고자 한다.
examples.translation: i geureseoneun epeu o sagowa gwallyeondoen hwangyeongjeok yoineul bunseokago daechaegeul jesihagoja handa. — In this article I intend to analyze the environmental factors related to the F-5 accidents and present countermeasures.

examples.text: 최근 강원도 강릉의 에프 오 사고는 여러 정황으로 보아 사고 원인을 예단하기가 쉽지 않아 보인다.
examples.translation: choegeun gangwondo gangneungui epeu o sagoneun yeoreo jeonghwangeuro boa sago wonineul yedanhagiga swipji ana boinda. — The recent F-5 accident in Gangneung, Gangwon Province, seems hard to judge in advance as to its cause, judging from the various circumstances.

examples.text: 그러나 다행스럽게도 기체가 온전히 수거됐기 때문에 시간이 걸리더라도 좀더 정확한 원인 규명이 가능할 것으로 예상된다.
examples.translation: geureona dahaengseureopgedo gichega onjeonhi sugeodwaetgi ttaemune sigani geollideorado jomdeo jeonghwakan wonin gyumyeongi ganeunghal geoseuro yesangdoenda. — But, fortunately, because the airframe was recovered intact, it is expected that a more accurate determination of the cause will be possible even if it takes time.

examples.text: 에프 오는 비록 노후한 전투기지만, 안전관리 여부에 따라 사전에 충분히 사고를 막을 수 있다.
examples.translation: epeu oneun birok nohuhan jeontugijiman, anjeongwalli yeobue ttara sajeone chungbunhi sagoreul mageul su itda. — Although the F-5 is an aged fighter, accidents can be sufficiently prevented in advance depending on whether safety is managed.

examples.text: 이번 기회에 한국에서도 비행 안전을 전담하는 기구가 설립되기를 기대한다.
examples.translation: ibeon gihoee hangugeseodo bihaeng anjeoneul jeondamhaneun giguga seollipdoegireul gidaehanda. — I hope that on this occasion an organization dedicated to flight safety will also be established in Korea.

examples.text: 그래서 앞으로 발생할 비행 사고의 위험으로부터 많은 생명과 재산을 지켜 낼 수 있기를 바란다.
examples.translation: geuraeseo apeuro balsaenghal bihaeng sagoui wiheomeurobuteo maneun saengmyeonggwa jaesaneul jikyeo nael su itgireul baranda. — So I hope that many lives and much property can be protected from the danger of flight accidents that will occur in the future.

rows: Eight of the eleven Air Force accidents since the 2000s were F-5 accidents; the recent F-5 accident in Gangneung, Gangwon Province (cause hard to judge, but the airframe was recovered intact)

Safety management can prevent accidents even with an aged fighter; establish an organization dedicated to flight safety in Korea, so that lives and property can be protected from future flight accidents

explanations.title: 말해 봅시다! (speaking)
explanations.body: The book’s speaking prompts (the English is mine):

examples.text: 최근에 일어난 사고나 아직도 기억하는 사고 뉴스가 있으면 이야기해 보세요.
examples.translation: choegeune ireonan sagona ajikdo gieokaneun sago nyuseuga isseumyeon iyagihae boseyo. — If there is an accident that happened recently or an accident news item you still remember, talk about it.

examples.text: 군대에서 범죄가 발생하면 어떻게 처리하는지 서로 이야기해 보세요.
examples.translation: gundaeeseo beomjoega balsaenghamyeon eotteoke cheorihaneunji seoro iyagihae boseyo. — Talk with each other about how crimes that occur in the military are handled.

explanations.title: Activities left out
explanations.body: 학습활동 1 (an interview with a railroad employee from the Seoul Education Research & Information Institute: his biographical information, a summary of his responses and reconstructing the reporter’s questions in Korean), 학습활동 3 (a lawyer’s story about a verdict: information on the son, father, mother and judge, and writing and performing a courtroom skit with a judge, mother, son, lawyer and prosecutor) and 학습활동 4 (a story about an incident involving a railroad employee: what happened and why, and which English proverb fits) are audio, skit and group activities.

explanations.title: 학습활동 1 (Reading): drunk-driving punishments abroad
explanations.body: The book shows a chart (Kyunghyang), “외국의 음주운전 처벌규정” (Punishment rules for drunk driving abroad), with four countries and their punishments, and asks you to fill in a table in English (country and punishment). The chart’s texts and my table:

rows: The names of those caught are published in the newspaper
Fines are also imposed on those who served the liquor and on those who recommended (the book’s “권한” appears to be 권유한) the drinking

explanations.title: 학습활동 4 (Reading): a newspaper article on a robbery
explanations.body: The following is a newspaper article about a crime (Yonhapnews). The book asks you to summarize the crime in English and describe the two suspects. The text is the book’s with the numbers and letters spelled out (7일 is 칠 일, 1시 45분께 is 한 시 사십오 분께, 2인조 is 이인조, 36만 원 is 삼십육만 원, 20대 초반 is 이십 대 초반, 2명 is 두 명, 173 cm is 백칠십삼 센티미터, CCTV is 씨씨티브이, A and B are 에이 and 비); the quotation marks are removed. The English is mine.

examples.text: 칠 일 대전경찰에 따르면 이날 오전 한 시 사십오 분께 대전 중구 용두동의 한 편의점에 이인조 강도가 들어 여종업원을 흉기로 위협하고서 현금 삼십육만 원을 빼앗아 달아났다.
examples.translation: chil il daejeongyeongchare ttareumyeon inal ojeon han si sasibo bunkke daejeon junggu yongdudongui han pyeonuijeome iinjo gangdoga deureo yeojongeobwoneul hyunggiro wihyeopagoseo hyeongeum samsibyungman woneul ppaeasa daranatda. — According to the Daejeon police on the 7th, at about 1:45 that morning two robbers entered a convenience store in Yongdu-dong, Jung-gu, Daejeon, threatened a female employee with a weapon, took 360,000 won in cash and ran away.

examples.text: 이 종업원은 경찰에서 차례차례 들어온 남자들이 갑자기 흉기를 꺼내 들어 위협하고 돈을 빼앗아 달아났다고 말했다.
examples.translation: i jongeobwoneun gyeongchareseo charyecharye deureoon namjadeuri gapjagi hyunggireul kkeonae deureo wihyeopago doneul ppaeasa daranatdago malhaetda. — This employee told the police that the men who came in one after another suddenly took out a weapon, threatened her, took the money and ran away.

examples.text: 경찰은 편의점에 설치된 폐쇄회로 씨씨티브이를 분석해 이십 대 초반으로 보이는 용의자 두 명을 공개 수배했다.

explanations.title: 학습활동 2 (Reading): crimes by military personnel
explanations.body: The following is a newspaper article about crimes committed by soldiers (Kyunghyang, text and image). The book asks you to write the most common type of crime in each military branch and to explain why crime in the Air Force is the most common. The text is the book’s with the numbers spelled out in the Sino-Korean style (8일 is 팔 일, 2005년 is 이천오 년, 6월 is 유 월, 25528건 is 이만 오천오백이십팔 건, and so on, 3군 is 삼 군); the English is mine. The book’s caption says the figures are from materials Representative Park Min-sik received from the Ministry of National Defense.

examples.text: 팔 일 국회 법제사법위원회 소속 한나라당 박민식 의원이 국방부로부터 제출받은 자료에 따르면 이천오 년부터 올해 유 월까지 군인이 범죄로 입건된 건수는 육군 이만 오천오백이십팔 건, 해군 사천백칠십팔 건, 공군 천팔백팔십오 건 등 모두 삼만 천오백구십일 건이었다.
examples.translation: pal il gukoe beopjesabeobwiwonhoe sosok hannaradang bangminsik uiwoni gukbangburobuteo jechulbadeun jaryoe ttareumyeon icheono nyeonbuteo olhae yu wolkkaji gunini beomjoero ipgeondoen geonsuneun yukgun iman ocheonobaegisippal geon, haegun sacheonbaekchilsippal geon, gonggun cheonpalbaekpalsibo geon deung modu samman cheonobaekgusibil geonieotda. — According to materials submitted by the Ministry of National Defense to Rep. Park Min-sik of the Grand National Party, a member of the National Assembly’s Legislation and Judiciary Committee, on the 8th, the number of cases in which soldiers were booked for crimes from 2005 to June this year was 25,528 in the Army, 4,178 in the Navy and 1,885 in the Air Force, a total of 31,591.

examples.text: 육군은 탈영으로 인한 입건이 오천백삼십육 건으로 가장 많았다.

lessons.title: 632. U15 L3 · Part 3 (심화 학습): disclosing the identities of criminals
lessons.subtitle: 심화 학습 · 무죄추정의 원칙 · 신상 공개 · 흉악범 · 피의자 인권 · 찬반 논란

explanations.title: 알아봅시다: 무죄추정의 원칙
explanations.body: 무죄추정의 원칙 refers to the principle of “presumption of innocence.” In other words, everyone charged with a penal offense is, by right, presumed innocent until proven guilty. This is in accordance with law that guarantees the accused high-quality defense in a public trial. This principle is stated in the Universal Declaration of Human Rights and in the Korean Constitution.

explanations.title: 학습활동 1 (Reading): an article on the criminal law amendment
explanations.body: The following is an article about an amendment of criminal law (Kyunghyang). The book asks you to choose which of four statements about the new law is true and to write the conditions that must be met before the amendment may be applied. The text is the book’s with 23일 spelled 이십삼 일; the quotation marks are removed. The English is mine.

examples.text: 법무부는 수사 과정에서 흉악범과 성폭력범에 대한 촬영을 허가하고, 얼굴 등 신상정보를 공개하는 인권보호를 위한 수사공보준칙 수사공보준칙 개정안을 시행한다고 이십삼 일 밝혔다.
examples.translation: beommubuneun susa gwajeongeseo hyungakbeomgwa seongpongnyeokbeome daehan chwaryeongeul heogahago, eolgul deung sinsangjeongboreul gonggaehaneun ingwonbohoreul wihan susagongbojunchik susagongbojunchik gaejeonganeul sihaenghandago isipsam il balkyeotda. — The Ministry of Justice announced on the 23rd that it will enforce a revision of the Rules on Public Information about Investigations for the Protection of Human Rights (the investigation public-information rules), which permits photographing brutal criminals and sex offenders during the investigation process and disclosing personal information such as their faces.

examples.text: 개정안에 따르면 특정강력범죄의 처벌에 관한 특례법과 성폭력범죄의 처벌 등에 관한 특례법에서 신상정보 공개를 허용하는 흉악범과 성폭력범은 기관장의 사전 승인을 받아 언론이 촬영 녹화 중계방송할 수 있고, 얼굴 실명 나이 등을 외부에 공개할 수 있다.
examples.translation: gaejeongane ttareumyeon teukjeonggangnyeokbeomjoeui cheobeore gwanhan teungnyebeopgwa seongpongnyeokbeomjoeui cheobeol deunge gwanhan teungnyebeobeseo sinsangjeongbo gonggaereul heoyonghaneun hyungakbeomgwa seongpongnyeokbeomeun gigwanjangui sajeon seungineul bada eolloni chwaryeong nokwa junggyebangsonghal su itgo, eolgul silmyeong nai deungeul oebue gonggaehal su itda. — According to the revision, brutal criminals and sex offenders whose personal information disclosure is permitted under the Special Act on the Punishment of Specific Violent Crimes and the Special Act on the Punishment of Sexual Violence Crimes can, with the prior approval of the head of the agency, be filmed, recorded and broadcast live by the media, and their faces, real names, ages and so on can be disclosed to the outside.

examples.text: 검찰은 공개 요건과 관련, 잔인하고 중대한 피해가 발생했고, 피의자가 죄를 범했다고 믿을만한 충분한 증거가 있으며, 알 권리 보장 및 범죄예방 등 공익을 위해 필요하고, 피의자가 청소년이 아닌 경우 등이라고 밝혔다.
examples.translation: geomchareun gonggae yogeongwa gwallyeon, janinhago jungdaehan pihaega balsaenghaetgo, piuijaga joereul beomhaetdago mideulmanhan chungbunhan jeunggeoga isseumyeo, al gwolli bojang mit beomjoeyebang deung gongigeul wihae piryohago, piuijaga cheongsonyeoni anin gyeongu deungirago balkyeotda. — Regarding the requirements for disclosure, the prosecution said they are cases in which cruel and serious harm has occurred, there is sufficient evidence to believe that the suspect committed the crime, it is necessary for the public interest such as guaranteeing the right to know and preventing crime, and the suspect is not a minor.

explanations.title: The questions answered (mine)
explanations.body:
1. The true statement is D. Prior to revealing the criminal’s identity, you must get approval from the authority (the head of the agency’s prior approval). A is wrong because brutal criminals as well as sex offenders are covered; B is wrong because the real name may also be disclosed; C is wrong because the article says nothing about waiting for a conviction.

2. The conditions (third paragraph): cruel and serious harm has occurred; there is sufficient evidence to believe the suspect committed the crime; disclosure is necessary for the public interest such as the right to know and crime prevention; and the suspect is not a minor.

explanations.title: 학습활동 2 (Reading): an article on the human rights of criminals
explanations.body: The following is an article about the human rights of criminals (Kyunghyang). The book asks you to state the main issue, summarize the pro and con arguments and say what happened to 강순정 and why 박주민 quoted his case. The text is the book’s with the age and numbers spelled out (38 is 서른여덟 살, 14살 16살 is 열네 살 열여섯 살, 2007년 is 이천칠 년); the quotation marks are removed. The English is mine.

examples.text: 법원 확정판결 전 용의자 단계에 있는 범죄 피의자의 얼굴 공개를 놓고, 논란이 일고 있다.
examples.translation: beobwon hwakjeongpangyeol jeon yonguija dangyee inneun beomjoe piuijaui eolgul gonggaereul noko, nollani ilgo itda. — Controversy is arising over disclosing the faces of criminal suspects who are at the suspect stage before a final court judgment.

examples.text: 성폭행이나 살인 용의자에 대해선 국민 알 권리와 범죄예방 차원에서 공개해야 한다는 주장과 인권보호 및 무죄추정의 원칙에 따라 공개하면 안 된다는 주장이 맞서고 있는 것이다.
examples.translation: seongpokaengina sarin yonguijae daehaeseon gungmin al gwolliwa beomjoeyebang chawoneseo gonggaehaeya handaneun jujanggwa ingwonboho mit mujoechujeongui wonchige ttara gonggaehamyeon an doendaneun jujangi matseogo inneun geosida. — For suspects of sexual assault or murder, the argument that they should be disclosed from the standpoint of the people’s right to know and crime prevention is facing off against the argument that they must not be disclosed according to the protection of human rights and the principle of presumption of innocence.

examples.text: 논란은 일부 언론에서 경기 서남부 부녀자 연쇄살인범 강호순 씨 서른여덟 살의 얼굴을 공개하자, 더욱 가열되고 있다.
examples.translation: nollaneun ilbu eolloneseo gyeonggi seonambu bunyeoja yeonswaesarinbeom ganghosun ssi seoreunnyeodeol sarui eolgureul gonggaehaja, deouk gayeoldoego itda. — The controversy has heated up further as some media disclosed the face of Mr. Kang Ho-sun (38), the serial killer of women in the southwest of Gyeonggi Province.

examples.text: 네티즌 한 모 씨는 강 씨 얼굴은 공개해야 한다. 범죄자 인권을 위해 일반 시민들의 인권을 희생할 순 없다고 밝혔다.
examples.translation: netijeun han mo ssineun gang ssi eolgureun gonggaehaeya handa. beomjoeja ingwoneul wihae ilban simindeurui ingwoneul huisaenghal sun eopdago balkyeotda. — A netizen, Mr. Han, said, “Mr. Kang’s face must be disclosed. We cannot sacrifice the human rights of ordinary citizens for the human rights of a criminal.”

examples.text: 김 모 씨도 연쇄살인범 얼굴 공개는 당연한 것이다. 사람을 동물 다루듯 잔혹하게 살해한 자에게 인권이란 단어는 사치라고 주장했다.
examples.translation: gim mo ssido yeonswaesarinbeom eolgul gonggaeneun dangyeonhan geosida. sarameul dongmul darudeut janhokage salhaehan jaege ingwoniran daneoneun sachirago jujanghaetda. — Mr. Kim also insisted, “Disclosing the face of a serial killer is natural. For a person who brutally killed people as if treating animals, the word human rights is a luxury.”

examples.text: 반면 홍 모 씨는 강 씨 얼굴 공개가 그렇게 중요하냐? 강 씨의 열네 살 열여섯 살 먹은 자식들을 생각해 봤냐? 그 아이들의 장래는 누가 책임질거냐?면서 반대했다.
examples.translation: banmyeon hong mo ssineun gang ssi eolgul gonggaega geureoke jungyohanya? gang ssiui yeolle sal yeollyeoseot sal meogeun jasikdeureul saenggakae bwannya? geu aideurui jangnaeneun nuga chaegimjilgeonya?myeonseo bandaehaetda. — On the other hand, Mr. Hong opposed it, saying, “Is disclosing Mr. Kang’s face that important? Have you thought about Mr. Kang’s children, who are 14 and 16? Who will be responsible for those children’s future?”

examples.text: 법조계도 의견이 나뉜다.
examples.translation: beopjogyedo uigyeoni nanwinda. — Legal circles are also divided in opinion.

examples.text: 박주민 변호사민주사회를 위한 변호사모임는 이천칠 년 간첩 혐의로 체포된 강순정 할아버지는 당시 언론에서 신상을 다 공개했는데 무죄가 됐다. 이런 경우 어떻게 보상하냐면서 비록 흉악범일지라도 인권을 존중해야 하고, 얼굴도 공개해선 안 된다고 말했다.
examples.translation: bakjumin byeonhosaminjusahoereul wihan byeonhosamoimneun icheonchil nyeon gancheop hyeomuiro chepodoen gangsunjeong harabeojineun dangsi eolloneseo sinsangeul da gonggaehaenneunde mujoega dwaetda. ireon gyeongu eotteoke bosanghanyamyeonseo birok hyungakbeomiljirado ingwoneul jonjunghaeya hago, eolguldo gonggaehaeseon an doendago malhaetda. — Lawyer Park Ju-min (of Lawyers for a Democratic Society) said, “Grandfather Kang Sun-jeong, who was arrested on spy charges in 2007, was found not guilty after the media disclosed all of his personal information at the time. How do you compensate in such a case?” and said, “Even if he is a brutal criminal, human rights must be respected and his face must not be disclosed.”

examples.text: 반면 하창우 변호사서울 변호사 협회장는 범인 공개수배 때 얼굴을 공개한다면서 하물며 이미 잡혀 반인륜적 범죄를 자백한 피의자 얼굴을 공개하지 않는 것은 모순이라고 말했다.
examples.translation: banmyeon hachangu byeonhosaseoul byeonhosa hyeopoejangneun beomin gonggaesubae ttae eolgureul gonggaehandamyeonseo hamulmyeo imi japyeo banillyunjeok beomjoereul jabaekan piuija eolgureul gonggaehaji anneun geoseun mosunirago malhaetda. — On the other hand, lawyer Ha Chang-u (president of the Seoul Bar Association) said, “We disclose faces when a criminal is publicly wanted,” and “It is a contradiction not to disclose the face of a suspect who has already been caught and has confessed to an antihumanistic crime.”

explanations.title: The questions answered (mine)
explanations.body:
1. The main issue: whether to disclose the faces of criminal suspects before a final court judgment (the people’s right to know and crime prevention versus human rights and the presumption of innocence).

2. The two sides:

rows: The people’s right to know and crime prevention; ordinary citizens’ human rights cannot be sacrificed for a criminal’s; a person who killed brutally does not deserve the word human rights; faces are disclosed anyway when a criminal is publicly wanted, so not disclosing the face of a caught suspect who confessed is a contradiction

Protection of human rights and the principle of presumption of innocence; the suspect’s children and their future; a suspect whose personal information was disclosed may turn out innocent, and then there is no way to compensate

explanations.title: The third question (mine)
explanations.body: 3. What happened to 강순정, and why did 박주민 quote his case? Mr. Kang Sun-jeong, an old man, was arrested on spy charges in 2007 and the media disclosed all of his personal information at the time, but he was found not guilty. Lawyer Park quoted the case to show that disclosure before judgment can wrongly harm a person who is later cleared, and there is no way to compensate.

explanations.title: 말해 봅시다! (speaking)
explanations.body: The book’s speaking prompts (the English is mine):

examples.text: 범죄자 신상공개에 대해서 찬성합니까? 반대합니까?
examples.translation: beomjoeja sinsanggonggaee daehaeseo chanseonghamnikka? bandaehamnikka? — Do you agree with disclosing criminals’ personal information? Do you disagree?

examples.text: 그 이유는 무엇입니까?
examples.translation: geu iyuneun mueosimnikka? — What is your reason?

examples.text: 반 친구들과 의견을 나누어 보세요.
examples.translation: ban chingudeulgwa uigyeoneul nanueo boseyo. — Share your opinion with your classmates.

explanations.title: Activities left out
explanations.body: 학습활동 3 (a YTN news clip about violent crime: the best title, the violent crimes the anchor mentions at the beginning, the relationship between a felony and the number of repeated offenses, and possible reasons for increasing repeat crimes) is an audio and video activity.

lessons.title: 635. U15 L4 · Part 1 (도입 학습): a table of weather disasters and speaking prompts
lessons.subtitle: 도입 학습 · 기상재해 · 옷차림 · 기상특보 · 일기예보 · 말해 봅시다

explanations.title: 학습활동 1 (Reading): weather disasters around the world
explanations.body: The book gives a table from Hankyoreh summarizing weather disasters in many countries, in tabs for Asian countries (North Korea, South Korea, China, Japan), European countries (Europe in general, the Netherlands, Great Britain) and countries in the Americas (the United States, Brazil), and asks you to translate the information of each tab into English. The tabs’ Korean texts are inside the picture and are not in the text of the book; only the two examples the book translates for you are in the text:

rows: Heavy rain, about 250 dead or missing (the book’s example)
July temperatures higher than in the past 95 years (the book’s example)

explanations.title: 학습활동 2: speaking pattern (보기)
explanations.body: In the pair activity you exchange questions and answers in Korean about the appropriate clothing for activities in various weather conditions, such as rain or snow. The book’s model questions (the English is mine; the spoken Korean has no slash):

examples.text: 추운 안개 낀 새벽에 조깅을 할 때 무엇을 입습니까?
examples.translation: chuun angae kkin saebyeoge jogingeul hal ttae mueoseul ipseumnikka? — What do you wear when you jog at a cold, foggy dawn?

examples.text: 비가 많이 오는 날에 외출할 때는 뭘 입어요?
examples.translation: biga mani oneun nare oechulhal ttaeneun mwol ibeoyo? — What do you wear when you go out on a day when it rains a lot?

explanations.title: 말해 봅시다! (speaking)
explanations.body: The book’s speaking prompt (the English is mine):

examples.text: 고향의 계절별 날씨와 고향에서 발생할 수 있는 자연재해에 대해 이야기해 보세요.
examples.translation: gohyangui gyejeolbyeol nalssiwa gohyangeseo balsaenghal su inneun jayeonjaehaee daehae iyagihae boseyo. — Talk about the weather in each season in your hometown and the natural disasters that can occur in your hometown.

explanations.title: Activities left out
explanations.body: 학습활동 2 (a conversation from edunet4u.net about dressing for the weather: the recommended clothing and other dos and don’ts for rainy and snowy weather), 학습활동 3 (an explanation of weather-related warnings: how they are announced and the conditions for which they are issued, such as typhoon, high sea waves and tsunami) and 학습활동 4 (two YTN forecasts: the season and the regional weather for the central and southern regions, Jeju and the south coast and Jiri Mountain; then reporting an English article about a region’s weather as a Korean radio broadcaster) are audio, pair and speaking activities.

lessons.subtitle: 본 학습 · 재해와 빈부격차 · 천재지변 · 인재 · 풍수해 · 칠레 지진 · 아이티 지진 · 빈익빈 부익부

explanations.title: 학습활동 3 (Reading): an editorial, “재해와 빈부격차” (Disasters and the gap between rich and poor)
explanations.body: The following is part of a newspaper editorial about natural disasters (Kyunghyang, text and image). The book asks three questions: how the title relates to the main idea, which comparison is made in the second paragraph, and a translation of the last two sentences with the implication. The text is the book’s with the numbers and letters spelled out (800~1000배 is 팔백 배에서 천 배, 70% is 칠십 퍼센트, 2달러 is 이 달러, WMO is 더블유엠오, 13일 is 십삼 일, GNP is 지엔피); the quotation marks are removed, and the Hanja 人災 after 인재 is dropped from the spoken lines. The English is mine.

examples.text: 자연재해는 천재지변으로 불린다.
examples.translation: jayeonjaehaeneun cheonjaejibyeoneuro bullinda. — Natural disasters are called acts of nature (heaven-made disasters and earth-made changes).

examples.text: 인간에 의해 일어나는 인재가 아니란 뜻에서다.
examples.translation: ingane uihae ireonaneun injaega aniran tteuseseoda. — This is in the sense that they are not man-made disasters caused by humans.

examples.text: 자연재해 중 큰 손실을 가져오는 재해는 지진과 화산 폭발, 풍수해다.
examples.translation: jayeonjaehae jung keun sonsireul gajeooneun jaehaeneun jijingwa hwasan pokbal, pungsuhaeda. — Among natural disasters, the ones that bring great losses are earthquakes, volcanic eruptions and wind-and-water disasters.

examples.text: 이 중 기상재해의 하나인 풍수해는 지구 온난화와 밀접한 관계가 있는 것으로 지적된다.
examples.translation: i jung gisangjaehaeui hanain pungsuhaeneun jigu onnanhwawa miljeopan gwangyega inneun geoseuro jijeokdoenda. — Of these, wind-and-water disasters, one of the weather disasters, are pointed out to be closely related to global warming.

examples.text: 자연재해라 하더라도 인간의 대응에 따라 피해 정도는 큰 차이가 난다.
examples.translation: jayeonjaehaera hadeorado inganui daeeunge ttara pihae jeongdoneun keun chaiga nanda. — Even if it is a natural disaster, the degree of damage differs greatly depending on human response.

examples.text: 천재지변에도 인재적 요소가 있다는 얘기다.
examples.translation: cheonjaejibyeonedo injaejeok yosoga itdaneun yaegida. — It means that even natural disasters have man-made elements.

examples.text: 그제 칠레를 강타한 지진의 위력은 지난달 아이티 지진의 팔백 배에서 천 배에 이르지만 인명 피해는 수백 명 정도로 추산된다고 한다.
examples.translation: geuje chillereul gangtahan jijinui wiryeogeun jinandal aiti jijinui palbaek baeeseo cheon baee ireujiman inmyeong pihaeneun subaek myeong jeongdoro chusandoendago handa. — The power of the earthquake that struck Chile the day before yesterday is 800 to 1,000 times that of last month’s Haiti earthquake, but human casualties are said to be estimated at several hundred.

examples.text: 평소 건물의 내진설계와 발 빠른 민 관 대응 등 지진에 강한 인프라를 구축해 놓았기 때문으로 분석된다.
examples.translation: pyeongso geonmurui naejinseolgyewa bal ppareun min gwan daeeung deung jijine ganghan inpeurareul guchukae noatgi ttaemuneuro bunseokdoenda. — This is analyzed to be because they had built infrastructure strong against earthquakes, such as earthquake-resistant building design and a quick civilian-government response.

examples.text: 두 나라 간 지질 환경과 지진 발생 지역의 차이 등도 주요 요인으로 꼽힌다.
examples.translation: du nara gan jijil hwangyeonggwa jijin balsaeng jiyeogui chai deungdo juyo yoineuro kkopinda. — The differences between the two countries in geological environment and in the areas where the earthquakes occurred are also counted as major factors.

examples.text: 국민의 칠십 퍼센트가량이 하루 이 달러 미만으로 생활하는 빈국 아이티로서는 재난 방지에 관심을 기울일 여유가 없을 것이다.
examples.translation: gungminui chilsip peosenteugaryangi haru i dalleo mimaneuro saenghwalhaneun binguk aitiroseoneun jaenan bangjie gwansimeul giuril yeoyuga eopseul geosida. — For Haiti, a poor country where about 70 percent of the people live on less than 2 dollars a day, there would be no room to pay attention to disaster prevention.

examples.text: 세계기상기구 더블유엠오는 지난 십삼 일 발표한 아이티 지진 보고서에서 지진 사망자 수는 일인당 국민소득 지엔피과 반비례한다고 지적했다.
examples.translation: segyegisanggigu deobeuryuemoneun jinan sipsam il balpyohan aiti jijin bogoseoeseo jijin samangja suneun irindang gungminsodeuk jienpigwa banbiryehandago jijeokaetda. — The World Meteorological Organization (WMO) pointed out, in the Haiti Earthquake Report it released on the 13th, that the number of earthquake deaths is inversely proportional to per capita national income (GNP).

examples.text: 자연재해에도 빈익빈 부익부 현상이 나타난다는 얘기다.
examples.translation: jayeonjaehaeedo binikbin buikbu hyeonsangi natanandaneun yaegida. — It means that the phenomenon of the poor getting poorer and the rich getting richer appears even in natural disasters.

examples.text: 국제적으로만 해당되는 말은 아닐 것이다.
examples.translation: gukjejeogeuroman haedangdoeneun mareun anil geosida. — It will not be a statement that applies only internationally.

explanations.title: The questions answered (mine)
explanations.body:
1. How the title relates to the main idea: the title, “Disasters and the gap between rich and poor,” states the editorial’s point that the damage from a natural disaster depends on a country’s wealth and preparedness: poor countries suffer far more than rich ones from disasters of the same kind.

2. The comparison in the second paragraph is A. Haiti suffered more damage than Chile from a less severe earthquake (Chile’s earthquake was 800 to 1,000 times more powerful, yet its casualties were only several hundred).

3. Translation of the last two sentences: “It means that the phenomenon of the poor getting poorer and the rich getting richer appears even in natural disasters. It will not be a statement that applies only internationally.” The implication: just as poor countries suffer more in disasters, within a single country the poor suffer more than the rich, because they cannot afford safe housing, preparation or recovery.

lessons.title: 639. U15 L4 · Part 3 (심화 학습): autumn syndrome and the verb 타다
lessons.subtitle: 심화 학습 · 가을증후군 · 가을을 타다 · 타다 · 설문조사 · 증상

explanations.title: 학습활동 1 (Reading): “여성, 남성보다 가을 더 탄다” (Women are more sensitive to autumn than men)
explanations.body: The following newspaper article is about autumn syndrome (Hankyoreh). The book asks five things: (1) which of the underlined 타다 verbs in eight sentences mean the same as in the title, and the meaning of each, (2) the English meaning of 가을증후군, (3) the symptoms in order of frequency, (4) a comparison of men and women, and (5) a pair discussion. The text is the book’s with the numbers spelled out (1362명 is 천삼백육십이 명, 49.7% is 사십구 점 칠 퍼센트, 27일 is 이십칠 일, and so on); the quotation marks are removed, and the book’s “여성(51.9%)이 남성(47.6%)보다” is written with the percentages in the clause so that it reads aloud naturally. The English is mine.

examples.text: 직장인 절반가량이 가을에 뚜렷한 이유 없이 외롭고 우울해지는 가을증후군을 겪는 것으로 나타났다.
examples.translation: jikjangin jeolbangaryangi gaeure tturyeotan iyu eopsi oeropgo uulhaejineun gaeuljeunghuguneul gyeongneun geoseuro natanatda. — It turned out that about half of office workers suffer from “autumn syndrome,” becoming lonely and depressed in autumn for no clear reason.

examples.text: 가을증후군은 가을에 접어들면서 우울함, 외로움 등 이유 없이 나타나는 심리적 증상을 말한다.
examples.translation: gaeuljeunghuguneun gaeure jeobeodeulmyeonseo uulham, oeroum deung iyu eopsi natananeun simnijeok jeungsangeul malhanda. — Autumn syndrome refers to psychological symptoms such as depression and loneliness that appear for no reason as autumn sets in.

examples.text: 취업포털 인크루트는 직장인 천삼백육십이 명을 대상으로 설문조사한 결과, 사십구 점 칠 퍼센트가 현재 가을증후군을 겪고 있다고 답했다고 이십칠 일 밝혔다.
examples.translation: chwieoppoteol inkeuruteuneun jikjangin cheonsambaegyuksibi myeongeul daesangeuro seolmunjosahan gyeolgwa, sasipgu jeom chil peosenteuga hyeonjae gaeuljeunghuguneul gyeokgo itdago dapaetdago isipchil il balkyeotda. — The job portal Incruit announced on the 27th that, as a result of a survey of 1,362 office workers, 49.7 percent answered that they are currently suffering from autumn syndrome.

examples.text: 성별로는 여성이 오십일 점 구 퍼센트, 남성이 사십칠 점 육 퍼센트로 여성이 더 많이 이런 증후군을 겪는 것으로 조사됐다.
examples.translation: seongbyeolloneun yeoseongi osibil jeom gu peosenteu, namseongi sasipchil jeom yuk peosenteuro yeoseongi deo mani ireon jeunghuguneul gyeongneun geoseuro josadwaetda. — By gender, it was found that women, at 51.9 percent, suffer from this syndrome more than men, at 47.6 percent.

examples.text: 증상으로는 외롭고 쓸쓸하다가 삼십육 점 영 퍼센트로 가장 많았고 우울하다 이십 점 칠 퍼센트, 신경이 날카롭다 십육 점 일 퍼센트 등이 뒤를 이었다.
examples.translation: jeungsangeuroneun oeropgo sseulsseulhadaga samsimnyuk jeom yeong peosenteuro gajang manatgo uulhada isip jeom chil peosenteu, singyeongi nalkaropda simnyuk jeom il peosenteu deungi dwireul ieotda. — As symptoms, “lonely and desolate” was the most common at 36.0 percent, followed by “depressed” (20.7 percent), “nerves on edge” (16.1 percent) and so on.

examples.text: 또 이런 증상은 업무에도 영향을 미치는 것으로 나타났다.
examples.translation: tto ireon jeungsangeun eommuedo yeonghyangeul michineun geoseuro natanatda. — Also, it turned out that these symptoms affect work as well.

examples.text: 업무에 집중이 안 된다는 답이 십일 점 칠 퍼센트였으며 계속 먹게 된다 사 점 오 퍼센트, 담배가 늘었다 사 점 영 퍼센트, 불면증에 시달린다 삼 점 팔 퍼센트 등의 차례로 응답이 많았다.
examples.translation: eommue jipjungi an doendaneun dabi sibil jeom chil peosenteuyeosseumyeo gyesok meokge doenda sa jeom o peosenteu, dambaega neureotda sa jeom yeong peosenteu, bulmyeonjeunge sidallinda sam jeom pal peosenteu deungui charyero eungdabi manatda. — The answer “cannot concentrate on work” was 11.7 percent, and the answers were many in the order of “keep eating” (4.5 percent), “smoking has increased” (4.0 percent), “suffer from insomnia” (3.8 percent) and so on.

examples.text: 가을증후군을 극복하기 위해 남성은 운동 이십구 점 이 퍼센트을, 여성은 수다 이십팔 점 사 퍼센트를 가장 많이 꼽았다.
examples.translation: gaeuljeunghuguneul geukbokagi wihae namseongeun undong isipgu jeom i peosenteueul, yeoseongeun suda isippal jeom sa peosenteureul gajang mani kkobatda. — To overcome autumn syndrome, men picked exercise (29.2 percent) most, and women picked chatting (28.4 percent) most.

explanations.title: The questions answered (mine)
explanations.body:
2. 가을증후군 means “autumn syndrome”: psychological symptoms such as depression and loneliness that appear for no reason as autumn begins.

3. The symptoms from most to least frequent: lonely and desolate (36.0%), depressed (20.7%), nerves on edge (16.1%); then the effects on work: cannot concentrate on work (11.7%), keep eating (4.5%), smoking has increased (4.0%), suffer from insomnia (3.8%).

4. Men and women: 51.9% of women and 47.6% of men suffer from it, so women suffer more. To overcome it, men most often pick exercise (29.2%) and women pick chatting (28.4%).

explanations.title: The 타다 sentences (my answers)
explanations.body: The book’s eight sentences A to H. The meaning box was 1. to mix, 2. to receive, 3. to burn, 4. to ride, 5. to be sensitive to; to be apt to feel. The two underlined verbs with the same meaning as the title’s 타다 (sensitive to) are D and H. My answers and translations:

explanations.title: The pair discussion (speaking)
explanations.body: Question 5 asks you to discuss in Korean which of the four seasons you are most sensitive to and whether you agree with the saying 여자는 봄을 타고 남자는 가을을 탄다 (women are sensitive to spring and men to autumn). The book’s 말해 봅시다 asks about natural disasters and relief activities. (The English is mine.)

explanations.title: 단어 복습 1: noun + verb ending (my answers)
explanations.body: The book asks you to write the English meaning of each noun and to tick the verb ending that can be attached to the noun (the first, 매몰, is done for you: 매몰되다). The three choices for each noun are the book’s; the ticked one is my answer, and the meanings are mine except for 매몰, which is the book’s.

explanations.title: 단어 복습 2: matching the natural-disaster sentences (my pairs)
explanations.body: The book asks you to connect each beginning on the left with the ending that fits (the endings: 날씨가 건조합니다; 도로가 물에 잠겼습니다; 성금과 구호품이 전달되었습니다; 산 아래 집들이 흙더미에 묻혔습니다; 쓰나미가 발생합니다; 생존자를 수색해야 합니다; 안전한 곳으로 대피해야 합니다). My pairs, written as whole sentences (the English is mine):

examples.text: 산사태 때문에 산 아래 집들이 흙더미에 묻혔습니다.
examples.translation: sansatae ttaemune san arae jipdeuri heukdeomie mucheotseumnida. — Because of the landslide, the houses at the bottom of the mountain were buried under piles of earth.

examples.text: 수재민들에게 성금과 구호품이 전달되었습니다.
examples.translation: sujaemindeurege seonggeumgwa guhopumi jeondaldoeeotseumnida. — Donations and relief goods were delivered to the flood victims.

examples.text: 가뭄이 심해서 날씨가 건조합니다.
examples.translation: gamumi simhaeseo nalssiga geonjohamnida. — Because the drought is severe, the weather is dry.

examples.text: 집중호우로 인해서 도로가 물에 잠겼습니다.
examples.translation: jipjunghouro inhaeseo doroga mure jamgyeotseumnida. — Due to the torrential rain, the roads were submerged in water.

examples.text: 사람들이 매몰되면 구조대가 생존자를 수색해야 합니다.
examples.translation: saramdeuri maemoldoemyeon gujodaega saengjonjareul susaekaeya hamnida. — If people are buried, the rescue squad must search for survivors.

examples.text: 바다 밑에서 지진이 일어나면 쓰나미가 발생합니다.
examples.translation: bada miteseo jijini ireonamyeon sseunamiga balsaenghamnida. — If an earthquake occurs under the sea, a tsunami occurs.

examples.text: 지진이 발생하면 안전한 곳으로 대피해야 합니다.
examples.translation: jijini balsaenghamyeon anjeonhan goseuro daepihaeya hamnida. — If an earthquake occurs, you must evacuate to a safe place.

lessons.subtitle: 도입 학습 · 압록강과 두만강 · 폭설 · 호우 · 가뭄 · 산사태 · 태풍 · 신의주 · 큰물 · 말해 봅시다

explanations.title: 알아봅시다: 압록강 and 두만강 (the Yalu River and the Tumen River) — the book’s note
explanations.body:
Both rivers originate from 백두산, the highest mountain in the Korean peninsula. 백두산 is located between North Korea and China. 압록강 runs 790 km along the border between North Korea and China and empties into the West Sea; 두만강 runs 521 km along the border between North Korea, China, and Russia, and empties into the East Sea. 압록강 is the longest river on the peninsula, with waters that are swift, deep, and voluminous, making it a good source of hydroelectric power. 수풍호 (Lake Soopoong) and 수풍댐 (Spoong Dam) are on the river and form the largest reservoir in North Korea. 신의주 is the largest North Korean city on 압록강.

두만강, in contrast, is relatively shallow and narrow, and is frequently used by North Korean defectors. Although heavily patrolled by North Korean guards, the river is easily crossed in spots on foot or by swimming. In 1995, the People’s Republic of China, Mongolia, Russia, and South Korea signed agreements to create the Tumen River Economic Development Area. The biggest city on 두만강 is 회령.

examples.translation: pyeonganbukdo sinuijuwa junggugui dandungeul yeongyeolhaneun amnokgang cheolgyoui moseubida. — This is the view of the Yalu River iron bridge connecting Sinuiju in North Pyongan Province and Dandong in China.
